module_mood_contract: M4 close: curious readiness ("I've built enough to try something; let's see what the agent does with it"). M5 open: read first, fix later — diagnostic contrast, not prescription. Pre-read function: prime the diagnostic lens and plant the question without resolving it. Mood at pre-read close: curious and primed, 8/10.

The second anchor (Sumner, added since the last audited pass) widens evidence without adding a fix or a named technique; it stays inside 'arm,' not 'teach.'
